info.name: SpotDraft V1 Contract APIs V2.1 Templates API

params.name: cp_types
params.description:
The type of Counterparty that can be added to contracts created from this template.
Must be either `Organisation` or `Individual`.
This value will be used to filter the list of templates returned by the API.
The template will be having one or more CP that match cp_types.

params.name: cp_types_all
params.description:
When a template has multiple counterparties, whether all counterparties should match the CP type given in cp_types.
False by default

params.name: exclude_multi_party
params.description: Whether templates that support multiple counterparties should be excluded.

params.name: include_archived
params.description: Whether archived templates should be included in the results.

params.name: tags
params.description:
The tags (if any) to filter the templates by.

Multiple tags can be specified by specifying the query param multiple times. Only templates where the Template tags are a subset of the tags passed will be returned.

params.name: tags_all
params.description:
The tags (if any) to filter the templates by.

Multiple tags can be specified by specifying the query param multiple times. Only templates where the tags passed are a subset of the Template tags will be returned.

items.docs:
Lists published templates available to the workspace tied to the API credentials.
Use query parameters to filter by tags, counterparty type, archive state, and multipart support.

Returns the template details available to the current workspace, including workspace-specific access data.
Use this before update calls when you need the current configuration state.

Updates the workspace-specific data stored against a template.
This is the version to use for self-serve and DraftMate-enabled template workflows.

Gets the list of fields required to create a contract with a given template.

The list of attributes returned define how a `contract_data` payload is to be
constructed for the [V2.1 Create Contract](#tag/v21-contract-apis/POST/api/v2.1/public/contracts/) request.
V2.1 must be used for templates created using the DraftMate Add-on.
